newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanians protesters clash with police in Tirana.
newsitem.headline: Albanians protesters clash with police in Tirana.

text.p: Protesters, enraged at losing their life savings in pyramid investment schemes, on Sunday clashed with police in Tirana as protests across Albania grew.
"People hurled stones pushing back riot police as they tried to head towards the Martyrs of the Nation boulevard (leading off the man square)," a witness said.

Between 1,000 to 2,000 demonstrators, who had joined an opposition rally numbering 30,000 people in a central Tirana soccer stadium, broke away after the meeting ended and ran straight into a wall of riot police.
Eyewitnesses said the police seemed reluctant to counter the barrage of stones but that the situation was tense.
At the rally, opposition leaders attacked the ruling right-wing Democratic Party of President Sali Berisha for allegedly exploiting the pyramid schemes for their own benefit.
"It is not the pyramid schemes which have gone bankrupt but Berisha's pyramid of power," Social Democrat leader Skender Gjinushi told the crowd.
